notes.title: Achievements are Live!
notes.notes:
Dear Steam Community,
 
We are happy to announce that Achievements for Beyond Good & Evil - 20th Anniversary Edition are now Live on Steam!
 
For those of you who had already started playing the game before, fret not: they are retroactive and will sync with your current progression a few minutes after you launch the game.
 
There are 34 Achievements to unlock, 22 of which are completely new and exclusive to this version of the game. Check the full list here: https://steamcommunity.com/stats/2556990/achievements
 
We wish you good luck in your hunt!
 
The Beyond Good & Evil Team.
